```{r include=FALSE, warning = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(here)

improve_data <- readxl::read_excel(here("Data/Raw Data/lifetable_data.xlsx"), sheet = "Improvement Factors 2020-22", skip = 2) |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  rename(male_25_year = x25_year_2, male_125_year = x125_year_3, female_25_year = x25_year_4, female_125_year = x125_year_5)

male_lifetable <- readxl::read_excel(here("Data/Raw Data/lifetable_data.xlsx"), sheet = "ALT 2020-22 Males", skip = 1) |> 
  janitor::clean_names()

female_lifetable <- readxl::read_excel(here("Data/Raw Data/lifetable_data.xlsx"), sheet = "ALT 2020-22 Females", skip = 1) |> 
  janitor::clean_names()
```

# Current Assumptions

- Minimum age to retire at (50 years)
- Maximum age of death (110 years)
- These imply a 60 year forecast horizon
- Each year, the horizon needs to be extended another year, if all other parameters stay constant

# Upgrades

- Can make mortality be based given survived to retirement age (rather than current age)


```{r}
# Improvement Rates for each age

improve_rates <- improve_data |> 
  select(age, male_125_year, female_125_year) |> 
  mutate(male_125_year = (100 + male_125_year)/100, 
         female_125_year = (100 + female_125_year)/100)
```


```{r}
# Base Mortality Rates

male_qx <- male_lifetable |> 
  mutate(qx = qx) |> 
  select(age, qx) |>
  bind_rows(data.frame(age = 110, qx = 1))
female_qx <- female_lifetable |> 
  mutate(qx = qx) |> 
  select(age, qx) |>
  bind_rows(data.frame(age = 110, qx = 1))
```


```{r}
# Forecasted Mortality Rates

male_qx_forecast <- matrix(data = male_qx$qx, nrow = 111, ncol = 64, byrow = FALSE)
rownames(male_qx_forecast) <- 0:110
female_qx_forecast <- matrix(data = female_qx$qx, nrow = 111, ncol = 64, byrow = FALSE)
rownames(female_qx_forecast) <- 0:110

for(j in 2:ncol(male_qx_forecast)){
  
  male_qx_forecast[,j] <- male_qx_forecast[,j-1]*improve_rates$male_125_year
  female_qx_forecast[,j] <- female_qx_forecast[,j-1]*improve_rates$female_125_year
}

male_mortality_df <- male_qx_forecast |> as_tibble() |> select(-(1:3))
colnames(male_mortality_df) <- seq(floor_date(as_date("2026-01-01"), "month"),
                                  floor_date(as_date("2086-01-01"), "month"),
                                  by = "year")
female_mortality_df <- female_qx_forecast |> as_tibble() |> select(-(1:3))
colnames(female_mortality_df) <- seq(floor_date(as_date("2026-01-01"), "month"),
                                  floor_date(as_date("2086-01-01"), "month"),
                                  by = "year")

write_csv(male_mortality_df, here("Data/Processed Data/male_mthly_mortality_forecast.csv"))
write_csv(female_mortality_df, here("Data/Processed Data/female_mthly_mortality_forecast.csv"))
```


```{r}
# Cumulative Survival Matrix

male_survival_df <- 1 - male_mortality_df
rownames(male_survival_df) <- 0:110

male_cum_survival_df <- data.frame(matrix(NA, nrow = 61, ncol = 61))
rownames(male_cum_survival_df) <- 50:110
colnames(male_cum_survival_df) <- seq(floor_date(as_date("2026-01-01"), "month"),
                                  floor_date(as_date("2086-01-01"), "month"),
                                  by = "year")

male_cum_survival_list <- as.list(rep(NA, 21))

for(z in 1:21){
  
  male_cum_survival_list[[z]] <- male_cum_survival_df[, z:61]
  male_cum_survival_list[[z]][,1] <- male_survival_df[50:110,z]
  
  for(j in 2:ncol(male_cum_survival_list[[z]] )){
    for(i in 2:nrow(male_cum_survival_list[[z]] )){

      if(i < j){
        male_cum_survival_list[[z]][i,j] <- NA
        
      } else {
        male_cum_survival_list[[z]][i,j] <- male_cum_survival_list[[z]][i-1,j-1] * male_survival_df[i+49,j]
      } 
      
    }
  }
    
}

names(male_cum_survival_list) <- 2026:2046
```


```{r}
# Cumulative Survival Matrix

female_survival_df <- 1 - female_mortality_df
rownames(female_survival_df) <- 0:110

female_cum_survival_df <- data.frame(matrix(NA, nrow = 61, ncol = 61))
rownames(female_cum_survival_df) <- 50:110
colnames(female_cum_survival_df) <- seq(floor_date(as_date("2026-01-01"), "month"),
                                  floor_date(as_date("2086-01-01"), "month"),
                                  by = "year")

female_cum_survival_list <- as.list(rep(NA, 21))

for(z in 1:21){
  
  female_cum_survival_list[[z]] <- female_cum_survival_df[, z:61]
  female_cum_survival_list[[z]][,1] <- female_survival_df[50:110,z]
  
  for(j in 2:ncol(female_cum_survival_list[[z]] )){
    for(i in 2:nrow(female_cum_survival_list[[z]] )){

      if(i < j){
        female_cum_survival_list[[z]][i,j] <- NA
        
      } else {
        female_cum_survival_list[[z]][i,j] <- female_cum_survival_list[[z]][i-1,j-1] * female_survival_df[i+49,j]
      } 
      
    }
  }
    
}

names(female_cum_survival_list) <- 2026:2046
```


```{r}
# Combining into tidy data-frame.
# Involves wrangling matrix into tidy format, and creating combinations of starting age and retirement age.

set.seed(123)

simulations <- lapply(male_cum_survival_list, function(x) calculate_death_years(x, death_rand = runif(1))) |> 
    bind_rows() |> 
    mutate(sim_id = 1, sex = "male") |> 
  bind_rows(
    lapply(female_cum_survival_list, function(x) calculate_death_years(x, death_rand = runif(1))) |> 
    bind_rows() |> 
    mutate(sim_id = 1, sex = "female")
  )

for(i in 2:5000){
  
  death_rand = runif(1)
  
  m <- lapply(male_cum_survival_list, function(x) calculate_death_years(x, death_rand = death_rand)) |> 
    bind_rows() |> 
    mutate(sim_id = i, sex = "male")
  
  f <- lapply(female_cum_survival_list, function(x) calculate_death_years(x, death_rand = death_rand)) |> 
    bind_rows() |> 
    mutate(sim_id = i, sex = "female")
  
  simulations <- simulations |> 
    bind_rows(m,f)
  
}

write.csv(simulations, here("Data/Processed Data/simulations.csv"))
```
